description: Three rounds of two flagged Steane [[7,1,3]] blocks in lockstep, one a Z memory and one an X memory (32 ions: 14 data, 12 check and 6 flag ancillas), then the data read out, each block in its own basis. Circuit distance 3; decoded with BP-OSD. Ranked with every Goal 1 code by the logical error rate per round per logical qubit under qccd-noise@2, with Helios-class physics in which every number is cited.
